title: Intermittent gateway latency
executive_summary: INC-010 reports intermittent api-gateway latency. The only clear signal is a p99 rise (baseline ~253 ms to ~300 ms window mean; a single 5-minute sample peaked at ~557 ms at 19:45Z, onset ~19:40Z). p95, error rate, timeout rate, request rate and CPU are flat versus baseline. Telemetry is heavily incomplete after 19:45Z (24/56 datapoints missing for api-gateway, 36/56 for order-service), so the incident window cannot be fully assessed. No deployments or config changes were recorded in the window. A cluster of slow SELECT report_rollup() statements in postgres (13-18 s, 19:34-19:42Z) overlaps the p99 onset, but postgres p99, CPU, connection utilisation and disk IO wait show no change, so no causal link is established. Root cause is not identified.

Monitor telemetry completeness (datapoint-missing rate) per service.

conclusion: Root cause could not be conclusively established with the available evidence. Evidence shows a modest, possibly transient api-gateway p99 increase (onset ~19:40Z) with flat p95, errors, timeouts, CPU and request rate. No deployments or config changes were recorded. Telemetry after ~19:45Z is largely missing for key services, which prevents confirming or excluding a cause. Postgres slow report_rollup() queries overlap in time but show no resource impact. Final status is INCONCLUSIVE; further trace and telemetry review is required.
